g.text: Restaurant Rush | Turn 7: activate, arrive and seat (sequence 2 of 4)
Entry: turn 6 completed; C1 PAID, C2 READY_TO_PAY.
T1 is free; T2 still contains C2 (payment happens later in turn 7).
UI has parsed HAPPY_HOUR. Failed phase/reuse checks throw before mutation.
Iterates existing customers in arrival order:
C1.recover(15) and C2.recover(15) leave PAID/READY_TO_PAY unchanged.
C3 does not exist yet. No recovery event at turn 7.
new RegularCustomer("C3", 7, 3) through the composition root.
Finds T1 from state.tables(), in creation order.
Page 3 continues in the same turn: ORDER C3, then PREPARE O3.
Queue and tables are separate: a queued customer can be selected by ID.
If the ID is not queued or no table is free, Seating returns rejected
before removal/seating; submit leaves HOST unchanged so UI retries.
Host uses the same Seating implementation as Waiter.
Expands beginTurn(true) and the Host action in the winning branch of page 1.
Exact method responsibility matters: Controller calls the arrival factory; Host delegates table selection to Seating.
